vulnerability.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
vulnerability.description: Vulnerabilities that allow attackers to inject client-side scripts
vulnerability.impact: Can lead to session hijacking, credential theft, or delivery of malware to users
vulnerability.mitigation: Apply context-aware output encoding, use Content-Security-Policy, validate and sanitize all inputs

findings.title: Vulnerability found
findings.explanation: The 'msg.sender' variable is used to compare with 'owner', which may contain user input. This opens the door for Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks.
findings.impact: An attacker could potentially steal session cookies, leading to credential theft.
exploitation_steps: Send a crafted amount parameter to the 'sendTo' function
The user input within 'msg.sender' is executed as JavaScript
findings.remediation: Sanitize all inputs, such as by using context-aware output encoding or Content-Security-Policy.

chunk_analyses.notes: Code is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via the user input in 'msg.sender'.

findings.title: Vulnerability found
findings.explanation: The function airDrop(), when called, does not sanitize the msg.sender input, potentially allowing an attacker to execute XSS attacks.
findings.impact: Session hijacking or credential theft via XSS payloads
exploitation_steps: Call the airDrop() function with a crafted XSS payload as the msg.sender
findings.remediation: Sanitize the input for msg.sender before using it in the tokenBalance[msg.sender] assignment.

findings.explanation: The code includes user input in the HTML comment section, which could allow an attacker to inject client-side scripts.
findings.impact: Can lead to session hijacking or delivery of malware to users
findings.execution_path_diagram: user -> comments (injection) -> web page -> victim user
exploitation_steps: Attacker injects malicious script in a comment
Victim visits the webpage with the injected comment
Script is executed on victim's client
findings.exploitation_conditions: Attacker can control the comments section of the page
findings.remediation: Sanitize all user-generated HTML content before rendering
